problem_statement: Build a brand-new Account Settings page from scratch at the /app/account route of this Windmill (@windmill/react-ui + Tailwind) admin dashboard. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the in-app 404 view. Construct the full page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (left sidebar + top header) and reuse the Windmill design system (PageTitle, Card, CardBody, Button, Input, Label, Select, the purple/gray color tokens). The page must present a settings-section tab switcher (Profile / Security / Notifications) that actually drives the content: clicking a tab must swap the visible section heading and its form fields. It must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: An 'Account Settings' page title rendered with the site's PageTitle heading component
A tab switcher with exactly three tabs labelled Profile, Security and Notifications, styled with the site's purple accent for the active tab
A Profile Details section (shown by default) with a full-name field, an email field and a preferred-language select, inside a Windmill Card
A Security Settings section with password fields and a two-factor authentication toggle
A Notification Preferences section with checkboxes for the different alert types
Clicking a different tab re-renders the visible section: the heading and the form fields swap to that tab's settings (e.g. clicking Security shows the Security Settings heading and password fields)
A primary 'Save Changes' button at the bottom of the card, styled with the site's Windmill Button
The whole page sits inside the dashboard shell (left sidebar nav + top header), consistent with the existing pages
design_constraints: Reuse the Windmill React UI components already used across the dashboard (PageTitle, Card, CardBody, Button, Input, Label, Select)
Register the page as an internal app route in src/routes/index.js (path '/account'), so it renders under /app/account inside containers/Layout — mirror how Cards/Forms/Tables pages are wired
Keep the site's purple/gray color palette and spacing; do not introduce a new visual language

Match the Windmill palette exactly: purple accent #7E3AF2 (rgb(126,58,242)) for the active tab, primary Button and focus/links; heading text near-black rgb(36,38,45); secondary/body text gray rgb(112,114,117); borders rgb(213,214,215); card/page background white on a #f9fafb page. Do not introduce any non-purple accent color.
Each section renders a visible heading with the exact text of that section: 'Profile Details', 'Security Settings' and 'Notification Preferences' respectively.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /app/account = top-level empty route in App.js (<Route exact path='/app/account' render={()=><></>} /> placed BEFORE <Route path='/app' component={Layout}/>) so it renders a blank #root OUTSIDE the layout shell (gotcha #12), instead of falling to the in-app 404 view; reference fully implements the Account Settings page with a working useState-driven tab switcher; bad renders the same page but removes the tab buttons' onClick and hardcodes activeTab='profile' so clicking Security/Notifications never changes the DOM (interaction_assertion fails while dom_assertions on the default Profile view still pass). Three workspaces md5-distinct. Windmill mounts internal pages under /app/* (App.js '/app'->Layout, Layout Switch prefixes /app to each routes/index.js path), NO basename/homepage -> state_plan path = /app/account. CRA5 (react-scripts 5) + react-router-dom 5.2 -> builds offline with NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider. No auth guard (Login page is cosmetic).
